summary: Clark Nelson, 66, of Garden City, Kansas: his SUV got stuck in a field over the weekend and he wandered away on foot; found safe Tuesday Feb. 11 in Cheyenne County by a Civil Air Patrol pilot who directed ground searchers to him after a six-county search (including Kiowa County); hungry and thirsty, no serious injuries
location: Cheyenne County, eastern Colorado (found; six-county search incl. Kiowa County)
responding_agency: Colorado Civil Air Patrol (air search); Kiowa County Sheriff's Office + multi-county ground searchers
notes: DATE PIN — CAP 'Colorado SAR Results' media-report PDF (parent-opened run 632): found safe 2014-02-11 (Tuesday); zero Cheyenne rows and zero Clark-Nelson rows before insert. Not the pre-2010/Kansas-only items: found in Cheyenne County, CO.
